subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — payment details, tax forms, PO setup (Novus Analytics)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@novusanalytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff — payment details, tax forms, PO setup (Novus Analytics)

Hi Elena —

Welcome — glad to kick off the vendor setup for Novus Analytics. To get you fully active in our procurement system and enable PO issuance and first payment, we need the items below. If you can get the primary items to me by EOD Thu (4/22) that would let us issue a PO the following week.

Required from Novus (minimum):
- Completed W-9 (signed PDF) OR W-8BEN-E (if non-US).
- Bank account details (completed template) for ACH — see attached CSV template.
- Legal company name exactly as you want it to appear on POs and invoices.
- Remittance address for mailed checks (if different).
- VAT registration certificate (EU vendors only) — if not applicable, reply N/A.

Optional but helpful:
- Copy of your standard invoice with line-item example.
- Contact for accounts payable (name + email + phone).

A few notes about our process: once we have the W-9 and bank details we create a vendor record and issue a PO number in our system. Standard payment terms are NET 30 unless otherwise negotiated. If you need a different cadence please flag now so we can loop in Finance.

I attached our onboarding checklist and the bank template to this message. Next steps:
1) You send W-9 + completed bank CSV + remittance address.
2) I create vendor record and confirm vendor code.
3) Finance issues PO and confirms expected payment date.

Thanks — let me know if you want to run through this on a quick call.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: Novus_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub), bank_account_template.csv (stub)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attaching our completed W-9 and bank details. A few quick clarifications:

- Novus Analytics is a US entity (EIN included on the W-9) — W-9 attached.
- VAT not applicable (we do not register for VAT in the US).
- Our AP team will accept ACH (preferred) or wire.
- Our AP contact is Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@novusanalytics.com>. You can loop her in on PO/invoice questions.

Regarding PO format: what prefix does Redwood use? Our systems sometimes require PO numbers to be in PO-######## format.

Uploading: Novus_W9.pdf (signed), Novus_bank_account_details.csv (filled). Please confirm receipt.

Please confirm the remittance address below for your invoices:

Chicago, IL 60601
